Using the Pipe Symbol |> to pass the result from the left side into the first argument of the function on the right side
```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)
results <- input_vec |>
  mean()|>
  abs()|>
  round()
print(results)
```

```{r}
y <- 12
y == 7
y < 15
y > 20
y <= 20
```
